Plumter is a fintech company that provides payment processing and financial technology solutions. The company offers services for international banking and foreign payments for businesses, including multi-currency transactions and secure payment transmission. It was founded in 2021 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.

Precium provides payment processing infrastructure for merchants in Africa. The company offers services such as local payment method integration, cross-border compliance, and transaction reconciliation. Precium serves merchants and enterprises in the African market. Precium was formerly known as Revio. It was founded in 2020 and is based in Cape Town, South Africa.

Capi provides international payment solutions for businesses. The company offers services that enable importers to pay their international suppliers in various currencies with tracking. Capi serves the e-commerce and import export sectors across the region. It was founded in 2023 and is based in Wilmington, Delaware.

Plumter is a fintech company that processes B2B cross-border payments. We are a simple, robust and compliant way to pay your business partners in global currency swiftly and safely.

At Plumter, we allow importers submit their payment details and initiate cross-border transactions securely and with ease. Our technology streamlines this process by automating the necessary KYC documentation, compliance, and foreign exchange calculations, ensuring efficient and accurate payments.

in 2022, the company was transitioning from consumer remittance into B2B cross border payments. I led the end to end design of the Vendor Platform across web and mobile, turning a largely manual payment process into a structured product businesses could use to create, manage, approve, and track payments independently.
Founding Product Designer
2022 to Present
My work spanned product architecture, payment creation, transaction lifecycles, onboarding, compliance touchpoints, team workflows, and the foundations of the design system.

A major part of the challenge was making the complexity of cross border payments easier for customers to navigate. I designed flows that adapted to different banking requirements, surfaced pricing and FX information at the right moments, reduced avoidable errors, and made transaction states, issues, and next steps easier to understand.

Over time, the platform replaced much of the manual coordination around payments with a shared product experience that could support Plumter as its customer base, payment volume, and operational complexity grew.
